sourceChangesReviewed: Camera path, chart bars, ticks and axes unchanged from previous source-bound review.
Stage wall raised to max(300,12*stageRadius), closed with seven dome rings and inward triangle fan. Far clip raised to max(300,40*stageRadius).
Checker validates planar nondegenerate inward supporting faces, convexity, opposite edge incidence two, and connected shell.
Checker requires perspective pinhole and no motion blur; camera and whole near rectangle must be within every shell halfspace at each baked pose.
Far bound uses actual world-space stage radial, bottom and pole extrema; per-pose stage rays compare camera-space hit depth to near/far.
Cap clipping has correct six halfspaces and conservative tolerance/screen expansion. For the frozen source, its declared 128-vertex spring ring matches the actual generated ring.
visualFindings: Both actual portrait flight stills retain matte blue faces with no visible backdrop top-edge arch.
Nearest bars are cropped during intentional passing closeup; these are not endpoint or native-overlay readability views.
